THE RESIDENCE

Jewel Keningston

64 two and three bedroom apartments are aesthetically designed making the best use of space 'Jewel Keningston' sits near the Info Park at Kakkanad. These luxury apartments are laden with amenities that pamper a laid back life style. Centralised gas supply, swimming pool, 24 hr water supply, most modern fire fighting equipments are some that cater to needs of the luxury loving resident here.
